g.text: SKILL 2 OF 5 · §2.2 PAPER2POSTER
Paper2Poster composes on four orthogonal axes, fills the page with a measured
loop, and exports native PowerPoint shapes
Figure 3: bundle → pick figures → compose poster.html → staged-fill loop → PDF, PNG, editable PPTX → deliverables gate
FIG. 3
ONE RUN, FOUR COUPLED FORMATS
A self-contained web page (the visual ground truth)
A print-resolution PDF at the exact venue canvas (60 × 36 in landscape for ICML /
NeurIPS / CVPR, A0 portrait for the ACL family)
A thumbnail PNG and a natively editable PowerPoint file
Optional per-section narration audio (Edge TTS or Azure Speech)

g.text: ID
Requirement
Solution the paper gives
A1
Composition without a template explosion — a bank of fixed
templates blows up across layout × style × header × QR block and
still makes posters look alike
Assemble at build time from four orthogonal axes: layout (full / half / three-column), style (11 interchangeable CSS themes), header (5
arrangements of venue logo, institution logos, QR), Scan-to-Read block; only the layout is fixed by a hard rule (the Method figure's shape),
the rest sampled reproducibly; every section carries a distinct widget
A2
A fill loop that converges — the band where a section reads full is
narrow and one discrete edit overshoots it
A staged, discrete measured-fill loop: five categorical verdicts select the move, one section per round, moves sized by the measured pixel
delta (next page)
A3
A page too large to re-read — a ~100 KB HTML file floods the
context and overflows the output channel
Each measurement returns only the verbatim source of off-target sections; the file is generated indirectly and never printed back, so neither
token budget is spent on the bulk of the page
A4
Figures that fill their cards — a figure absorbs whatever room the text
leaves and can strand as a small stamp
Size each figure through its height cap and hold it to a hard floor on its card; a figure below its cap is enlarged by raising the cap, a crowded
column is relieved by trimming text; the floor is a termination condition
A5
A faithful editable export — a reopenable poster needs native
shapes, not a pasted image
Rebuild each slide from the live DOM: text → editable frames keeping bold/italic, figure → replaceable picture, equation → native equation
object, section card → styled shape; edit in PowerPoint without re-running the loop
Source: arXiv:2607.04438 v2 (19 Jul 2026)
